review_scope: dashboard query units and environment isolation

findings.finding: Cross-environment aggregation could mask a failed environment.
findings.resolution: Contract requires one environment per rule evaluator; dashboard requires one explicit non-All environment and every surface query filters it.

findings.finding: A live heartbeat alone could falsely imply usable SLO evidence while an observation or histogram series is absent.
findings.resolution: Each surface enumerates required_series; missing rules use absent() for every required metric plus a >300-second heartbeat timestamp test, and activation requires bounded-series preinitialization.

findings.finding: Mixed ratio and latency targets could render misleading dashboard units.
findings.resolution: Public latency and withdrawal short-window targets have explicit field unit overrides; stable refIds are validator-covered.

optimization_readback: Kept one provider-neutral contract, one dashboard, one rule file and one runbook; cache-purge remains only a withdrawal safety invariant and no unapproved normal-publish SLO was invented.
